site.name: Bus Info
site.description: Look up any bus in Sweden, the UK, Australia or New Zealand by number plate or fleet number.

home.title: Which bus is that?
home.signLabel: Plate, fleet number or vehicle ID
home.placeholder: TYPE A PLATE OR FLEET NO
home.intro: Type a number plate, the fleet number painted on the bus, or the vehicle ID from a live feed. You'll get its age, where it is now and photos of it.
home.coverage: Live positions come from public realtime feeds in Sweden, England, New South Wales, Queensland, Victoria, Auckland, Wellington and Christchurch.
